title: Crying Doll and Spiral Witches
description: A broken doll with wide screaming mouth and cracked eyes lies on the floor in a decaying room, surrounded by scattered rings and debris. Three eerie female faces with spiral-patterned hair emerge from the wall, staring down at a glowing green smiley-face orb that casts light onto a dark reflective pool containing miniature figures.
prompt: Surreal horror scene of a broken porcelain baby doll with wide open screaming mouth and cracked eyes lying on the floor of a decaying room, three eerie women's faces with elaborate spiral and circular patterned hair emerging from the wall above, staring down intently, a glowing green smiley face orb floating above a dark reflective puddle containing tiny figures and golden rings, black ink linework with selective green glow, unsettling atmosphere, detailed textures, surreal nightmare aesthetic
